title: Reality-Seam, Temporal/Dream & Contextual Spatial Laws
objective: Implement fuzzy Reality/layer/boundary/bleed state bindings; preserve explicit traversal/access separation; temporal recurrence/reset conditions; dream/causal/symbolic route predicates; Environment/Reality owner bindings; and deterministic context-state replay/explanation without treating bleed as access or inventing hidden contextual causes.
acceptance: Fuzzy layer/boundary/bleed state is explicit owner-backed context, not inferred hidden truth.
Dimensional bleed, visibility and traversal/access remain distinct; bleed alone never grants traversal.
Temporal recurrence/reset affects only declared state categories and preserves immutable Event history.
Dream/causal/symbolic route predicates consume explicit owner-authorized context and fail unresolved rather than inventing truth.
Reality/Environment context versions are recorded and stale context fails closed before consequential evaluation.
Context-state replay reconstructs declared deterministic behavior and role-safe explanation filters hidden causes.
Blocking contextual-law workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, provider-off and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03/04 and upstream completed programs remain sealed.
World/Reality/Environment owners retain canonical contextual state and cause truth.
Transition/Portal/Access owners retain traversal authority; MSLR contextual bleed or visibility never self-authorizes access.
Knowledge/Visibility owners retain participant knowledge and authorized explanations.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history.
MSLR-08 and later tranches remain unauthorized until MSLR-07 closeout.
next_action: Await the next owner Continue. That command may governed-start only MSLR-07.
